# Flyology TUI

Flyology TUI is an experimental Ada terminal UI toolkit. It uses one serial
Elm-style owner, bounded component state, Unicode-aware surfaces, responsive
layout snapshots, mouse capture, terminal color profiles, and render-time
skins.

Canonical site: https://tui.flyology.org/
Guide: https://tui.flyology.org/guide/
Components: https://tui.flyology.org/components/
Architecture: https://tui.flyology.org/architecture/
GNATdoc API: https://tui.flyology.org/api/
Source: https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-tui

Important boundaries:

- One runner-owned task mutates and presents the live model.
- Commands and external tasks exchange detached typed values only.
- Components own bounded local state and no hidden task or callback.
- Applications own focus, overlay order, modal routing, and heterogeneous
  child models.
- The same immutable responsive geometry should drive render and hit testing.
- Themes and skins are borrowed render-time values.
- Backends own terminal lifecycle. Renderers own frame differencing.

Every public Flyology_TUI.Components child package has one generated page under
https://tui.flyology.org/components/. Each page links to its exact GNATdoc
compilation unit and includes generated previews for all maintained skins.
